 “I’m a beauty editor with rosacea – this is the SPF I’ll be using all winter long”
 Beauty 
 By Lucy Partington 
 29 minutes ago brought-to-you-by   Altruist Credit: Lucy Partington
 Credit: Lucy Partington
 3 min read
 save for later
 Make us preferred on Google
 SPF should be non-negotiable in every routine – and this one is lightweight, affordable and formulated for rosacea-prone skin.
 If you know me, you’ll be more than aware that I’ve spent the vast majority of my career writing about the importance of wearing sunscreen all year round. Even when it’s cold outside and there’s not even a hint of sunshine in the sky, wearing SPF should be a daily non-negotiable.
 But I get it: as somebody who was finally diagnosed with rosacea a few years ago (after a lifetime of red, sore, sensitive cheeks) finding a formula that’s gentle enough to use day in, day out, that’ll work to support your skin barrier and fit in seamlessly with the rest of your routine isn’t an easy task. Especially when you’re as fussy as I am – because for an SPF to actually make it into my daily rotation, it has to be lightweight, comfortable on my skin, layer well with the rest of my routine and sit well underneath my make-up. 
 Credit: Lucy Partington
 And that’s where Altruist’s expert formulas come in – a brand that’s loved and respected by so many of my fellow beauty editors, it’s the brainchild of consultant dermatologist Dr Andrew Birnie. Its aim? To formulate high quality sunscreen at an affordable price, which it does so well, and while I’ve used some of the brand’s formulas over the years, its Anti-Redness & Pigmentation Tinted Facial Moisturiser SPF50 is a new favourite.
 Available in original and light versions – I use light – the green-tinted cream immediately helps neutralise the appearance of redness, evens out skin tone and provides broad-spectrum SPF50 protection. It’s quickly become my daily go-to, mostly because of how lightweight it is, meaning I can apply a generous amount (two fingers’ worth, which is the recommended amount to get adequate protection) without feeling – or looking – like I’m wearing too much.
 The coverage is enough for me to skip foundation on an everyday basis, which is another big part of the appeal. My skin still looks like skin, just more even, and with the redness disguised enough that I don’t feel the need to add anything else if I can’t be bothered – but on the days I do want more coverage, it works well underneath my usual foundation.
 There’s so much to love about the hardworking formulas, too. Both versions harness the power of iron oxides to protect against pigmentation, as well as panthenol and glycerin to hydrate and reduce irritation, all while supporting the skin barrier. The original also contains soothing centella asiatica, an ingredient more commonly known as cica. And finally, both are non-comedogenic (meaning it won’t clog pores), fragrance-free and water resistant. Tick, tick, tick.
 For me, it really does bring together all the little things I’m most particular about: high protection, a comfortable texture, a finish that works with or without make-up and an affordable price point, something I believe is important when it comes to products you use every single day. Plus, finding a sunscreen I actually enjoy applying makes that daily step easy – and this one won’t be leaving my routine any time soon.
 Shop Altruist Anti-Redness & Pigmentation SPF50 and Anti-Redness & Pigmentation Light SPF50 now.
